en.dr-ali-peiravi: 66-37 I heard Aba Nasr Muhammad ibn Al-Hassan al-Karkhi al-Katib say, “These verses are written on the grave of De’bel al-Khoza’ee: Prepared De’bel for the Day on which to meet God‘There is no god but God.’He testified to it with sincerityHoping forgiveness from God in the HereafterGod is his Master and nextComes the Prophet and his Trustees.the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds” [Qur’an, 78:18]
